name: Marquee
description: Marquee is a self-hosted web app for managing your Plex media posters for Movies, TV Shows, TV Seasons, and Collections. Import every poster from Plex, then refine each one in place by uploading your own art, pasting an image URL, or picking a replacement from an online poster search. Updated posters are sent back to Plex and locked so Plex keeps your choice. Includes a Poster Wall slideshow with a live "now playing" view.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Marquee web interface

variables.name: PLEX_SERVER_URL
variables.description: URL of your Plex Media Server, e.g. http://192.168.X.X:32400

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the config volume (99 = nobody on Unraid)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the config volume (100 = users on Unraid)
